2607.21209.title: Explainability Framework for Policy-Aware Autonomous Agents
2607.21209.paper_summary: In the field of Artificial Intelligence, an agent is a system which is able to autonomously make decisions in order to reach a desired goal. As these systems grow more prevalent in our day-to-day lives, there has been an increased need to add explainability features which can provide an account for an agent's behavior. We therefore propose a framework that outlines how to produce comprehensible explanations for policy-aware agents, or agents which have rule-enforcing policies incorporated in their decision-making framework. This framework is designed using insights from the social sciences on how to produce good explanations. It is implemented in the Answer Set Programming language while using Python to assist with information extraction and natural-language translation. Because these agents incur penalties when violating policies, we are able to leverage these penalties to detect undesirable events in scenarios that are counterfactual to the agents' original actions. This lends itself to creating contrastive explanations (e.g., "the agent performed this action because, had it not, undesirable event X would have occurred."), which formulate the core component for our explainability framework. The framework is evaluated using a survey wherein human participants provide feedback on our program-generated explanations.
2607.21209.paper_summary_zh: 在人工智慧領域中，代理是一種能夠自主做出決策以達成期望目標的系統。隨著這些系統在我們日常生活中變得越來越普遍，對於增加可解釋性功能的需求也隨之增加，這些功能可以解釋代理的行為。因此，我們提出了一個框架，概述如何為政策感知代理生成可理解的解釋，或是將執行規則的政策納入其決策框架的代理。該框架是基於社會科學的見解設計的，旨在生成良好的解釋。它是使用答案集程式設計語言實現的，同時利用Python協助信息提取和自然語言翻譯。由於這些代理在違反政策時會受到懲罰，我們能夠利用這些懲罰來檢測在與代理原始行為相反的情境中發生的不良事件。這使得創造對比解釋成為可能（例如，“代理執行此行動是因為，如果不這樣做，不良事件X將會發生。”），這構成了我們可解釋性框架的核心組成部分。該框架通過一項調查進行評估，其中人類參與者對我們程序生成的解釋提供反饋。
2607.21209.author: Heather Merhout et.al.
